{{Top|fa}} {{Otheruses|Vanik}} {{Character |type=Resistance |image=[[File:Seftin_Vanik.png]] |name=Seftin Vanik |homeworld=[[Messert]]''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' |birth= |death=[[35 ABY]], [[Exegol]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|IX}}, which include Vanik's [[death]] on [[Exegol]], to [[35 ABY]]. |species=[[Human]]''[[Star Wars: Character Encyclopedia, Updated and Expanded Edition]]'' |gender= |pronouns=He/him |height=1.67 [[meter]]s {{C|5[[Foot|ft]] 6in}} |mass= |hair=[[Color|Black]] |feathers= |eyes=Black |skin=Light |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*An [[Unidentified aerial circus|aerial circus]]''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' *[[Resistance]] **[[Resistance Starfighter Corps]] **[[Exegol air team]]{{Film|IX}} |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Air team's gonna find the tower, ground team's gonna blast it.''"
"''Ground team?''"
"''I have an idea for that.|Finn and Vanik|audio=Finn-Vanik-GroundTeam-TROS.flac|}} '''Seftin Vanik''' was a [[human]] [[Resistance pilot|pilot]] from [[Messert]] who served as a [[lieutenant]] in the [[Resistance]]. Formerly a stunt flyer in an [[Unidentified aerial circus|aerial circus]] that traveled the [[Messert system]], Vanik was recruited into the Resistance by fellow [[pilot]] [[Poe Dameron]], flying an [[RZ-2 A-wing interceptor]] in various [[Starfighter combat|dogfights]] for the movement. In [[35 ABY]], he was stationed on the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|Resistance base]] on the [[moon]] of [[Ajan Kloss]], where he attended a briefing for a [[Battle of Exegol|mission]] on the [[planet]] [[Exegol]] against [[Sith Eternal military|Sith Eternal forces]]. As a member of an [[Exegol air team|air team]], Vanik participated in the Battle of Exegol, protecting the [[Exegol landing team|ground team]] tasked with destroying a [[navigation tower]] that would allow the [[Sith Eternal]]'s [[fleet]] to leave the planet. During the battle, Vanik was shot down and [[Death|killed]] alongside several other Resistance pilots. ==Biography== ===Serving the Resistance=== {{Quote|We're gonna show them we're not afraid.''"
"''What our mothers and fathers fought for, we will not let die. Not today. Today, we make our last stand.|Finn and Poe Dameron address the Resistance at a briefing prior to the Battle of Exegol|audio=FinnPoe-LastStand-TROS.flac|}} Hailing from the [[planet]] [[Messert]], Seftin Vanik learnt flight skills in the [[Messert system]] and operated as a stunt [[pilot]] for an [[Unidentified aerial circus|aerial circus]] that traveled around the [[Star system|system]] during the [[New Republic Era]]. When Messert seceded from the [[New Republic]], Vanik questioned his loyalties as he believed in the [[The galaxy|galaxy]]-wide government. He eventually became a [[lieutenant]] in the [[Resistance]] after being encouraged by [[Resistance pilot]] [[Poe Dameron]], who had witnessed one of the stunt pilot's performances in the circus, possibly attracted by Vanik's reckless nature.{{EncyclopediaCite|The Resistance}} Vanik subsequently participated in various [[Starfighter combat|dogfights]] with enemy [[starfighter]]s as an [[RZ-2 A-wing interceptor|A-wing]] pilot. Vanik eventually earned the nickname of "Shield Cooker" for his habit of flying through explosions resulting from his close-proximity hits. At one point, he narrowly evaded a [[TIE series|TIE fighter]] unit over the [[Core Worlds]] planet{{Databank|corellia|Corellia}} [[Corellia]]. At another point, Vanik and a [[Resistance transport]] flew away from a celestial body while being pursued by a [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter|First Order TIE]].{{FFGXW2|set=Heralds of Hope Squadron Pack|cardname=Seftin Vanik}} [[File:VanikChireen-TROS.png|thumb|left|300px|Vanik and Nimi Chireen watch as General Organa is escorted to her living quarters.]] In [[35 ABY]], Vanik was stationed at the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|Resistance base]] on the [[jungle]] [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]]. He was seated at a console and was monitoring a screen with fellow pilot [[Nimi Chireen]] when [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], the Resistance's leader, [[The Force|sensed]] a [[Mission to Kef Bir|conflict]] between her [[Ben Solo|son]] and her [[Rey Skywalker|apprentice]]. Vanik and other members of the Resistance watched as Lieutenant [[Kaydel Ko Connix]] escorted Organa to the latter's living quarters,''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition]]'' where she soon [[Death|passed away]] from [[Force power|exerting]] the last of her strength through the Force to connect with her son. A large crowd then gathered around Organa's body to mourn her death in silence, with Vanik standing next to the pilot [[Nien Nunb]] in the living quarters. It was during that [[time]] when Vanik also learned that the [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|''Xyston''-class Star Destroyers]] operated by the [[Sith Eternal]]'s [[fleet]], the [[Final Order]], powered their [[Axial superlaser|superlaser cannons]] using the [[Star Destroyer|ships']] main [[reactor]]s. He later attended a briefing hosted by Dameron—who had been promoted to the [[Military rank|rank]] of general alongside fellow Resistance member [[Finn]] following the death of Organa—as he detailed the Resistance's [[Battle of Exegol|mission]] to the planet [[Exegol]] in the [[Unknown Regions]]; they were to eliminate the [[Sith Eternal military|Sith Eternal forces]] along with their fleet. When Finn displayed a [[hologram]] of a [[navigation tower]] that would allow the fleet to leave the planet, he explained that a [[Exegol landing team|ground team]] would sabotage the tower. As a member of the [[Exegol air team|air team]] covering the ground team, Vanik was surprised''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel]]'' and questioned why a ground team was required, to which Finn replied he had a plan for them. ===Battle of Exegol=== {{Quote|Watch your starboard, Wexley.''"
"''Whoa!|Vanik, to Temmin Wexley|audio=Vanik-Wexley-TROS.flac|}} After the briefing concluded, Vanik and other Resistance pilots entered their [[Starship|ships]] and took off, traveling to Exegol through the [[Red Honeycomb Zone]]. Upon arriving at the planet, Vanik and the Resistance forces were immediately bombarded by the [[Sith]] Star Destroyers' [[ion cannon]]s. Flying his [[A-wing starfighter|A-wing]], Vanik turned his ship around and warned [[Major]] [[Temmin Wexley]] to watch the starboard of his [[Temmin Wexley's X-wing|X-wing]] before flying by him. When the signal of the navigation tower was switched to the Sith fleet's [[command ship]], the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Steadfast (Resurgent-class)|''Steadfast'']], Finn ordered the [[Fortitude (transport)|transport]] carrying the ground team to land on the Star Destroyer instead. [[File:Vanik-Death-TROS.png|thumb|right|300px|Vanik perishes on Exegol.]] Hearing Finn's order, Dameron ordered all pilots to cover their landing. As the battle progressed, many Resistance pilots lost their lives. Vanik was shot down and killed when his A-wing was struck by enemy fire, engulfing the ship in [[Fire|flames]]. While the Resistance was on the brink of defeat, a [[Citizens' Fleet|large fleet]] of ships arrived at Exegol, led by General [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]]. With the help of the fleet, the Resistance destroyed the remaining Sith forces and emerged victorious, returning to Ajan Kloss to celebrate. ==Personality and traits== Vanik was a [[human]] with [[Color|black]] [[hair]], black [[eye]]s, and light skin. He began doubting where his loyalties stood after witnessing the New Republic government leave his homeworld. After fitting in quickly with the Resistance, the pilot was a daring member who frequently engaged in point-blank dogfights with enemy fighters, a trait that his [[wingmate]]s teased him for. Following his escape from a group of TIEs over Corellia, Vanik was eager to pilot his A-wing again. Vanik preferred A-wings as he loved to fly at very high speeds. He stood 1.67 [[meter]]s (5 [[foot]] 6 inches) tall. ==Skills and abilities== After becoming a Resistance pilot, Vanik was a highly skilled{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2020/9/23/fight-to-the-finish|text=Fight to the Finish}} and brave [[ace]] pilot, a status that made him a suitable wingman. He earned the nickname "Shield Cooker" as a result of flying through explosions caused by his close-proximity hits on enemy fighters, which pushed his A-wing's [[Deflector shield|shields]] to its limits. ==Equipment== As a Resistance pilot, Vanik flew a green-striped RZ-2 A-wing [[interceptor]]. He wore a light-colored [[flight suit]] made of undyed fabric along with a [[KSE-H44 A-wing pilot helmet]] and a pair of brown insulated [[flight glove]]s. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|They're drawing on the main reactors!|Vanik's dialogue during the Resistance's briefing on Ajan Kloss in the novelization|audio=Vanik-MainReactors-TROSEE.flac|}} [[File:JosefAltin.jpg|thumb|250px|Vanik was portrayed by Josef Altin.]] Seftin Vanik was portrayed by [[Josef Altin]] in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']]. His surname was revealed in the film's credits, listed as "Pilot Vanik," while his first name was identified in the accompanying reference book, ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition]]'', the film's [[2020]] novelization written by [[Rae Carson]], features a number of differences from the film itself. During the briefing on Ajan Kloss, [[Rose Tico]] informs the Resistance that her team has been analyzing the Sith fleet's Star Destroyers, stating that they require a large power source for their [[superlaser]] [[cannon]]s. Vanik adds that the cannons draw power from the reactors. In the film, Tico only states that the ships could be destroyed by targeting the cannons, while Vanik does not speak. Another difference in the novelization is presented during the battle on Exegol when Vanik warns Wexley to watch his starboard while the latter is pursued by a group of [[TIE/dg starfighter]]s moments before the major's death, while the film shows him saying the line at the beginning of the battle. The scene from the novelization is also detailed in the film's [[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel|junior novelization]] by [[Michael Kogge]]. This article follows the film's version of events involving Vanik. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Seftin Vanik|soundcat=Audio files of Seftin Vanik}} *{{Film|IX}} {{1st}} *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition (audiobook)}} *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel (audiobook)}} *[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker (Screen Comix)|''Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker'' Screen Comix]] ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[William Shakespeare's The Merry Rise of Skywalker: Star Wars Part the Ninth]]'' ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' {{1stID|Seftin}} *{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2020/9/23/fight-to-the-finish|text=Fight to the Finish}} *{{FFGXW2|set=Heralds of Hope Squadron Pack|cardname=Seftin Vanik}} *''[[Star Wars: Character Encyclopedia, Updated and Expanded Edition]]'' *{{EncyclopediaCite|Princess Leia Organa}} {{Po}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|The Resistance}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Databank|resistance-pilots|Resistance Pilots}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Seftin Vanik |es=Seftin Vanik |fr=Seftin Vanik |ja=セフティン・ヴァニク |pl=Seftin Vanik }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Vanik, Seftin}} [[Category:Aces]] [[Category:Exegol air team personnel]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Resistance Military officers]] [[Category:Resistance Starfighter Corps personnel]]
